newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Aug 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Aug 18.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
A Panama flag ship with 5,000 metric tonnes of rice caught fire early on Sunday at the outer anchorage of the Mongla port.
The government is considering to float a new bond for the non-resident Bangladeshis.
Nine more financial institutions have been given primary approval to operate as merchant banks in the capital market.
All the seven countries of the SAARC will hold a three-day meeting in Dhaka from August 27 to discuss introduction of air services interlinking the South Asian capitals.
Asian Development Bank (ADB) President Mitsuo Sato will arrive in Dhaka on Saturday on a four-day visit for appraisal of Bangladesh's futrure development agenda.
Former President and opposition Jatiya Party cheif Hussain Muhammad Ershad returned home on Sunday after a month-long trip to Saudi Arabia, Britain and India.
A bill seeking to have a Central Depository System (CDS) in dealing of securities at the stock exchanges is likley to be introduced in the coming session of the parliament.

Business groups are mounting pressure on the government for chartering ships to ferry goods from Singapore to offset a punitive congestion surcharge imposed by the Singapore-based feeder operators. REUTER
